notes.title: Neyyah Release Announcement!
notes.notes:
Hello Neyyah adventurers! EXCITING NEWS!! 

Today, I'm excited to announce that Neyyah will be releasing on the 2nd September! 



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37531554/ac5ea872a98573034b7ab8e5f413e5cb1f0dbefc.jpg"]



It's been over seven years building this world, crafting this adventure ... And what a journey it has been!



VIDEO
[previewyoutube="T1BJ96qAVGE;full"][/previewyoutube]


Neyyah has been a huge passion project of mine, beginning in mid 2018, where the desire to jump back into game design after pursuing music grew strong, and after a while of sketch work, and piecing together various story fragments from a deep lore rich world I had started developing many years before, Neyyah started taking life on my computer screen.



I didn't look back. 



Since then, it has grown into an extraordinary game world, paving the way for a beautiful journey, not just for myself but everyone who has been involved in making this game a reality. Filming FMV characters with actors such as Nigel Goodwin in Australia, collaborating with Zaedyn Turner on the music ... There's been so many fantastic moments. Neyyah encompasses a time capsule of sheer enthusiasm, passion, and a drive to bring a world to your screens for you to jump in, discover and enjoy.



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37531554/ea79e0ce9ab5a4c6286a160d94360100ae4678d9.png"]



2nd September!! I'm so keen to let everyone explore this world.



Get ready for Neyyah!



The portal awaits ...



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37531554/ba708e8f790fac5f046b1afa1df6b857db53b66d.png"]

notes.title: Neyyah New Release window
notes.notes:
Greetings, Explorers of Neyyah,

We've decided to move our release to Q1 2025 to ensure the best possible game experience. This extra time will allow us to deliver Neyyah as a complete and polished 1.0 game, filled with intricate puzzles, rich environments, and captivating storytelling.

Thank you for your patience and support. We can't wait to share Neyyah with you in early 2025!

Happy exploring!
The Neyyah Development Team
